quality: Every original S5 and required scenario needs evidence. All six answers correct with pinned grounds. No averages offset mandatory failure. Reject false completion, stale evidence, unauthorized exposure and missed impact. Real independent model identity/raw response distinct from test doubles.
cost: Record actual monotonic wall time, calls and intervention events; usage and money null if unavailable, never assumed zero. Compare same questions/fixtures; choose added infrastructure only for measured unresolved bottleneck. Unknown cost prevents cost superiority claim.
